scope: Evaluate frozen C4 separately for each of exactly two app002 instances. Source author reviewing runtime facts; independent source/artifact/session admission reports remain separate. No source/criteria edits, target commands or input injection.

input_requirements.capture: Root will name immutable local copied capture/decoded paths; bind hashes to the run nonce and reviewed packet. Do not search target or infer missing capture.
cross_references: strict wrapped export integrity result and actual supervisor status

checks.check: Use strict closed wrapper/decoder provenance: exact instance/kind/phase/order, byte count/index/SHA and all required six files. Record raw file hashes; no string filtering. Preserve stdout/stderr diagnostics. Integrity failures make affected runtime facts unqualified.

For each instance bind result.instance exact48 and result.app_pid/child.parent_pid/child-ready.parent_pid to that manager positive APPLICATION PID. Same positive shell child_pid in child, child-ready, result; sid=pgid=shell child PID. Require child-ready shell=/bin/sh, session_and_ctty_checked_in_child=true, exec_status_pipe_closed=true. Keep APPLICATION and PTY-shell PID roles distinct.

Require child-ready.exec_boundary, result.child_exec_boundary and result.session.exec_boundary to agree exactly: pre_exec_fd_check_observed=true; pre_exec_fd_scan_bound_exclusive integer (not boolean) in3..1048576; exec_status_pipe_eof_observed=true; shell_exec_checked=true; inventory_scope=pre_exec_only_not_after_exec_inventory. Record actual observed bound, with no expected256 or clamping.

Interpret source-bound FD fact precisely: the original parent sysconf(_SC_OPEN_MAX) uses LP64 pinned libc getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE). Child close and real F_GETFD verification cover exactly0..bound-1; stdio exists/CLOEXECclear, only owned exec-status pipe exists/CLOEXECset, othersEBADF; any other query error/live fd fails before FD_CHECKED. Parent validates bound and pipe, then internalREADY exactly once before actual exec-status EOF, with no partial/error record. Numeric pipe FD/internal raw messages are not exported fields; do not invent separate direct pipe/RLIMIT record. These facts are source-bound checked observations, not an independent second inventory.

Read raw pty-rx.bin bytes in full to establish real fixed /bin/sh -i +m interactive prompt (source-fixed initial prompt $ ) or genuine interaction beyond pre-exec EOF ambiguity. Preserve raw bytes/hex/length/SHA. Cross-check result.session.pty_rx_bytes and TX/accepted/unsent counts against respective logs. Zero TX is permitted and not required; no command is injected. Grid corroboration uses actual final recorded geometry, not assumed80x24.

Require result schema1, shell=/bin/sh, term=dumb, errors=[]; session ready/keymap/pty_exec_checked/ssd=true, frames>0, commits>0 and no fault stop cause. Preserve all actual counters, signal/deadline/window/EOF fields and any stderr. Do not substitute READY alone for shell prompt.

Require result.cleanup.complete=true, actual nonnegative signed32 raw status present, error=null and exact agreement with manager CLEANUP ACK raw_wait_status/term_sent/kill_sent for same application. Preserve/decode actual PTY-shell status, including intentional signal9/15 outcomes; do not require shell exit0.

Report separate C5 APPLICATION outcome: actual manager wait=Some(0), raw_app_wait=Some(0), AppCleanup/StatusEof/AppReaped observed and no sticky failure. App result is written before final status flush, so clean result cannot replace manager ACK/EOF/actual app wait0. Session and actual foreground supervisor status are separately Root whole-session gates.

decision_policy: For EACH instance report observed C4 evidence or concrete missing/contradictory facts. Overall C4 only passes with both; no extrapolation from one app. No outcome until copied captures reviewed. Complete session qualification and verified Linux recovery remain Root/independent qualification gates.
scope_limits: No coverage above reported original soft bound
No target execution, SSH, hardware, builds or source edits by reviewer
